description: Five coding-agent stacks, the same verbatim brief, each building the same 3D game from an empty folder in one session, in parallel, on 2026-09-07 (2026-09-06 BRT evening for codex-astra; claude-qwen38 ran later the same day, after the first four). Source vendored under demos/<arm>; per-arm self-reports under results/<arm>.md; this file is the single source of numbers for the dashboard.
brief:
You are going to create a complete and impressive 3D demo runner game, using modules and libraries to reduce the need of new code. You should search the web for most updated information, stack and best practices. Select the stack based on easiness to implement a functional demo on reduced time. Question me for decisions and ambiguities while creating the plan.

- SAVE a detailed SPEC AND PLAN to SPEC.md and PLAN.md on the folder before building
- Create an AGENTS.md explaining the repo objective, poiting to both PLAN and SPEC files

arms.statsSessionNote: Its own STATS.md states plainly it excludes the session that wrote the file ("O relatório não inclui os tokens usados para criar este arquivo."). A verification pass against the Codex session logs found the excluded-session explanation accounts for the direction of a self-report/log gap but not its full size (see results/codex-astra.md).
arms.multiModelNote: This arm's ~18.6M-token total spans THREE models (gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol, codex-auto-review) across FIVE delegated agents running partly in parallel. The other three arms each ran a single model in a single agent. codex-astra's token total is therefore NOT comparable to the other three arms' totals — this is a larger caveat than the statsSessionIncluded convention above.

arms.label: Claude Code + Qwen3.8 Flash Next (local)
arms.statsSessionNote: Its own STATS.md counts the stats request as one of its six user prompts and runs its wall clock to the extraction moment, so the session that wrote the file is inside its own totals.

configNote: Run configuration for each arm, transcribed from that arm's own report named in `source`. A field the report does not state is null, never guessed; none of these reports records a reasoning effort or thinking level.
shortNote: A short display name for each arm, for chart rows and other narrow places. It names the same arm as `label`; it measures nothing.
skillsNote: `skills` lists the skill libraries loaded in that arm's session. Four of the five ran with superpowers; opencode-qwen38 is the arm without it. For the first four the operator stated it on 2026-09-08 and the per-arm reports do not record it; for claude-qwen38 the session transcript carries the library, though the build session invoked no skill through the Skill tool.
